sample_unit: MEN-related topics (ChatGPT texts and matched UpToDate articles)

links.outcome: Readability (FRE, FKGL) of ChatGPT-generated MEN patient education text versus UpToDate
links.effect: ChatGPT FRE 21.3 and FKGL 15.3; UpToDate FRE 24.9 and FKGL 16.7; both above suggested readability limits for patient materials.
links.quote: Both sources scored poorly in readability: ChatGPT had an FRE of 21.3 and FKGL of 15.3, while UTD scored 24.9 and 16.7, respectively.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of ChatGPT's baseline readability when generating patient education materials on multiple endocrine neoplasia syndromes compared to UpToDate, without testing a specific deployment practice or intervention.
